title: Star Ocean: The Second Story - Mission to the Deep Space
description:
The upbeat outer space theme from the Star Ocean: The Second Story. This port was created in the Super Famicompo 2 contest (Cover12) and placed 10th. Good for space levels, and it inserts large due to its length.

This version fixes the higher trumpet notes.
